info.name: RegTrack Insights
info.description: RegTrack Insights paid-tier + free-digest endpoints. Hosted on the existing RegTrack .NET 8 API under /api/insights. Auth = the host's existing bearer/session auth; set {{bearerToken}} in the environment. `tenantId` is always server-validated against the caller's eligible set (IDOR guard). See docs/INSIGHTS_API_ENDPOINTS.md and API_CONTRACTS.md.

request.description: No params. 200 with { tenants: [...] }. Empty array is a 200, not an error (secure-deny state). tier: pro|basic. scopeClass: tenant_wide|functional|entity_scoped.
Contracted in API_CONTRACTS.md §2 but NO route exists in the API yet. Returns { reports: [...], cooldown: {...} }. Rows filtered by report_scope ⊆ viewer_scope at request time.

reportType: compliance_health | fixed_holistic | dimension_selection.
scope: { "type": "tenant" } OR { "type": "entity", "entityId": 92442 }.
requestedDimensions: ONLY for dimension_selection - e.g. ["Location","Nature","Act"]. One request with N dimensions = one run = one report = one file. null for every other type.

202 -> { runId, status: "queued", streamUrl }.  409 COOLDOWN_ACTIVE + nextAvailableUtc.  403 TENANT_NOT_ELIGIBLE / SCOPE_DENIED.
3 dimensions in ONE request -> ONE run, ONE report, ONE HTML file with 3 sections. Not 3 runs.

Server-Sent Events. Connection capped at 15 min; the run continues, reconnect to resume. Event: { runId, status, stage, stagesComplete, stagesTotal }. stage: gathering -> validating -> composing -> narrating -> verifying -> rendering -> complete. Terminal status: complete | failed. On complete the payload carries the new reportId. Postman's runner does not stream SSE well - use curl -N or the browser for the live view.

reportId (path, GUID) + tenantId (query). Re-resolves scope NOW, decrypts, mints a FRESH short-lived read SAS every call (nothing stored, nothing reused).

200 -> { contentUrl, expiresUtc, sandboxRequired: true }. The client MUST render contentUrl only in <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts"> with NO allow-same-origin.

404 REPORT_NOT_VISIBLE for every refusal (missing / wrong tenant / scope no longer covers) - existence is never revealed.  403 TENANT_NOT_ELIGIBLE.

query.description: HMAC over (customer,user), issued when the mail was sent

request.description: NO login (email clients cannot auth). Safety is the t token. 200 { message }. 400 invalid ids / bad token. 500 signing key unconfigured.

Posted by the mail provider (no RegTrack account - protect like other inbound webhooks). Only bounceType 'hard' suppresses (durable). Soft bounce = recorded + ignored. 200 either way; 400 invalid ids.
